assumptions.name: quarter_extra_GM_HBM_quarter_unmodelled_cost
assumptions.meaning: At native resident B, the synthetic reference step is 50% long-history KV service, 25% batch-independent common cost, 25% per-request common cost. OSCAR uses source-counted KV and other GM requests. Extra unpack/compute/launch/sync/merge costs beyond counted byte service are a separately assumed, non-overlapped 25% of native history service per request. None of these shares is inferred from current device evidence.
assumptions.units: Native 19-FULL-call once-per-KV long-history read at the native resident batch equals 1 time unit. No seconds, clock frequency or absolute tokens/s conversion.

scope: Stationary pure decode, no APC, same net KV budget, conditional local model shape, same KV length each draft call. 17 q4+2 q1 history/precise-window sources. Assumed service rate and additive unmodelled costs; no resource overlap fitted.
not_calibrated: F and L common cost shares
gamma equivalent HBM fraction (not raw L2 hit rate)
exclusion_accounting: Common stages are only represented by assumed F/L; OSCAR-exclusive missing stages are only represented by assumed U. No claim these assumptions bound or fit actual cost.
